subject: Discovery recap + request to book senior-leader intro and demo window
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Thornton <alexa@finopsco.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposed next step (senior leader intro + demo)

Hi Alexa —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Helpful to hear where FinOpsCo is on model-driven cost allocation and the two main blockers you called out: (1) proving deterministic latency under customer scale and (2) integrating inference cost attribution into your billing pipeline.

I promised a short recap and concrete next step to keep momentum:

- Recap (2 min): you want to validate latency at 99th percentile with a production-like workload and confirm token-cost attribution for per-customer billing.
- Ask from you: can we schedule a 30–45m senior-technical intro between your CTO (or head of platform) and our VP of Engineering to discuss runbook/SLAs, then follow with a 45m technical deep-dive/demo on a staging dataset?

Suggested owners: Jordan (sales) + Karthik (solutions) and on your side Alexa + Michael (CTO) + procurement as needed.

Availability I can bring:
- Tue 9/7 09:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 9/8 13:00–16:00 PT
- Fri 9/10 08:30–11:00 PT

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a pricing summary so Michael and procurement have context before the call. If those look good, I can have Stephanie (copied) lock a slot and send a calendar invite.

Next step: Can you confirm Michael's availability windows or suggest two 30–45m options next week?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood_pricing_summary_v2.pdf

From: Alexa Thornton <alexa@finopsco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@finopsco.com>, procurement@finopsco.com
Date: 2026-09-02T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed next step (senior leader intro + demo)

Jordan —

Appreciate the recap and the MAP. High-level: this is aligned with our goals. I've looped in Michael (our CTO) and procurement so they have visibility. Michael — are you open to a short intro next week to go over reliability/SLAs? If so, please indicate preferred windows.

A couple quick clarifications for the MAP before we lock time:
- Will Redwood provide a simulated load test plan we can run alongside our staging traffic?
- Can you confirm whether token-level attribution requires any on-host agents, or if it can be done purely server-side with logs/IDs?

We can be flexible but would prefer the intro earlier in the week; Michael, any availability Mon/Tue morning?

Thanks,
Alexa Thornton
Director, Platform Engineering | FinOpsCo
alexa@finopsco.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@finopsco.com>, Alexa Thornton <alexa@finopsco.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed next step (senior leader intro + demo)

Michael and Alexa —

Thanks for the quick reply. To answer Alexa's clarifications:
- Load testing: yes — Karthik will own a staged load plan and we can share a runnable script and expected traffic profile ahead of the deep-dive.
- Token-level attribution: this is achieved server-side by passing customer_id as a request attribute and exporting per-request logs; no on-host agent required. We will include an integration checklist in the MAP.

Michael — you mentioned Mon/Tue mornings. Per Alexa's comment, how does Monday 9/7 at 9:30 PT look for a 30m caller between you and our VP Engineering (we'll invite Karthik + Stephanie to join)? If that doesn't work, we can offer Tue 9/8 09:30 PT.

Stephanie — can you lock Monday 9/7 09:30–10:00 PT if Michael is good? Also please attach the short runbook we use for SRE-level conversations.

Cheers,
Jordan
